_provenance: Global agricultural-region reference for the CropAtlas 'Comparable agricultural environments' panel. This file is INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. The repository contains no verified global agricultural-region dataset (no FAO/ agro-ecological-zone reference, no non-Indian region profiles), so CropAtlas ships the matching architecture with zero regions rather than inventing well-known farming regions to populate the UI. Adding a region here is the single step required to make the feature return matches.
